notes: Reliance publishes no state-by-state figures. The only location counts are in the BRSR 2024-25 (company-hosted; it covers standalone Reliance Industries Limited, not the 403,000-employee consolidated group): 15 plants and 62 offices in India, 0 plants and 2 offices abroad. The same table says RIL served 35 Indian states and union territories and exported to 108 countries in FY2024-25. The Integrated Annual Report 2024-25 says Reliance Retail's store count reached 19,340 ("The business opened 2,659 stores during the year, taking the total store count to 19,340 stores"), with no split by state, and it is not combined with the BRSR row because it comes from another document on a group basis. Sites come from the report's "Plant Locations in India" list (standalone RIL). Nagothane Manufacturing Division is omitted because the list does not state its location separately; Vadodara Composites Division and 2 Compressed Biogas plants in Uttar Pradesh are omitted for the 12-site cap. Jio, Retail and other subsidiaries' facilities are not listed.
